about: The film's shot list. Put a real capture from a v1 run in this folder under its name and the film uses it; until then stage.ts makes a stand-in in dist/film/stand-ins/. PNGs are 2x; rects in the .json sidecars are CSS px of the capture. Light theme, the built-in display only, nothing but the Linkbox sample and Maya.

assets.what: The opening: a long Files changed tab of an agent-written PR, the wall nobody reads.
assets.stand_in: None: the film draws the rows itself from diff.patch (the hook is a dramatised PR).
assets.real: A full-page capture of a GitHub Files tab, 1280 CSS px wide. No repo name in view.

assets.what: Rows for the hook's diff when there is no diff-files-tab.png.
assets.stand_in: Every Linkbox change end to end.

assets.what: The one Claude Code frame: Maya's agent finishing the Linkbox tags work, just before /storydiff.
assets.stand_in: A light transcript from session.json (the real prompt, numstat and test count).
assets.real: A capture of the terminal pane only (no window chrome), light theme.

assets.what: The PR conversation with the card as the first comment.
assets.real: A full-page capture of the demo PR, 1280 CSS px wide.

assets.what: { width, card: rect }: where the card sits in pr-comment.png, for the push in.
assets.real: Optional. Without it the push aims at the middle of the page.

assets.what: The UI + API card's HTML (storydiff render --html). The whiteboard draws it piece by piece.
